answer: Long unbonding with retroactive slashing: rewards an agent earns stay bonded for 60 days before they can be withdrawn, and any proof surfacing in that window that two accounts share one operator burns the bonded balance of both. Honest agents just wait; a Sybil farm has no safe haven, because each fake keeps a growing pile at risk and one leak can sweep the whole ocean of clones. The attacker's real cost is the delta between instant cash-out and months of exposed capital.
